INSERT INTO fund_holding ( id, fund_code, report_date, stock_code, stock_name, disclosed_weight, market_value, holding_rank, source, source_time, fetch_batch_id, data_version, checksum, quality_status, quality_reason, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.fundCode}, #{item.reportDate}, #{item.stockCode}, #{item.stockName}, #{item.disclosedWeight}, #{item.marketValue}, #{item.holdingRank}, #{item.source}, #{item.sourceTime}, #{item.fetchBatchId}, #{item.dataVersion}, #{item.checksum}, #{item.qualityStatus}, #{item.qualityReason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
ON CONFLICT (fund_code, report_date, stock_code) DO UPDATE SET stock_name = EXCLUDED.stock_name, disclosed_weight = EXCLUDED.disclosed_weight, market_value = EXCLUDED.market_value, holding_rank = EXCLUDED.holding_rank, source = EXCLUDED.source, source_time = EXCLUDED.source_time, fetch_batch_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fetch_batch_id, fund_holding.fetch_batch_id), data_version = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.data_version, fund_holding.data_version), checksum = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.checksum, fund_holding.checksum), quality_status = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.quality_status, fund_holding.quality_status), quality_reason = EXCLUDED.quality_reason, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE fund_holding.stock_name IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.stock_name OR fund_holding.disclosed_weight IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.disclosed_weight OR fund_holding.market_value IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.market_value OR fund_holding.holding_rank IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.holding_rank OR fund_holding.checksum IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.checksum OR fund_holding.quality_status IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.quality_status OR fund_holding.quality_reason IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.quality_reason
mapper.select: SELECT stock_code, stock_name, disclosed_weight AS weight, disclosed_weight, market_value, holding_rank AS rank_no, holding_rank, report_date AS report_date, to_char(report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS report_period, source, source_time, data_version, quality_status FROM fund_holding WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND report_date = ( SELECT MAX(report_date) FROM fund_holding WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} ) ORDER BY holding_rank NULLS LAST, disclosed_weight DESC, stock_code

SELECT stock_code, stock_name, disclosed_weight AS weight, disclosed_weight, market_value, holding_rank AS rank_no, holding_rank, report_date, to_char(report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS report_period, source, source_time, data_version, quality_status FROM fund_holding WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND report_date = #{reportDate} ORDER BY holding_rank NULLS LAST, disclosed_weight DESC, stock_code

SELECT 'FUND_HOLDING' AS dataset, fund_code, report_date AS business_date, fetch_batch_id, data_version, checksum, quality_status, quality_reason, source, source_time FROM fund_holding WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} ORDER BY report_date DESC, holding_rank NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
